e01.saheli: बरें जालें फ्रान्सिसबाब. नाश्तो वेळार करात.

e02.saheli: रीडिंग बरी आसा फ्रान्सिसबाब. विश्रांती घयात.

e03.saheli: फ्रान्सिसबाब, भरपूर उदक पियेयात आनी विश्रांती घयात. मेलरॉयक कळोवंक जाय जाल्यार सांगात.

e04.saheli: खूब बरी गजाल फ्रान्सिसबाब. सांजेचें भोंवप भलायकेक बरें.
e04.text: फाल्या सावन दरदीस सांजे 6:30 pm भोंवडो.

e05.saheli: हय फ्रान्सिसबाब, परबेचे दिस सदांच खोशयेचे आसतात. सगलीं तयारेक लागल्यांत?

h001.saheli: Thank you, Melroy. I have noted Baba's routine, conditions, and doctor details carefully, and I will be here to assist him every day.
h001.text: Hi Saheli, setting things up for my father Francis, please call him 'Baba'. He has Acidity and Osteoarthritis (knees), and Dr Joanna Prabhu manages his care. He is allergic to penicillin. His daily medicines are Pantoprazole 40 mg at 06:00, Domperidone 10 mg at 08:45, Sitagliptin 100 mg at 09:00, Folic acid 5 mg at 09:00, Calcium + Vitamin D3 500 mg at 14:00, Rosuvastatin 10 mg at 21:30, and Tamsulosin 0.4 mg at 21:30.

h002.saheli: बरे बाबा, BP नोंद करून घेतली. आज तब्येत बरी दिसता.

h004.saheli: मन्ना डे-चीं गाणीं मनाक शांतताय दितात, बाबा. संज वेळार तीं आयकुपाक खूब बरें दिसता.
h004.text: दर संजयेर मन्ना डे-चीं कांतारां आयकतां. आवडटात म्हाका.

h005.saheli: हय बाबा, परबेचो आनंद वेगळोच आसता. घरांत तयारी सुरू जाली काय?

h006.saheli: बाबा, संजयेर ९:३० वरांचेर Rosuvastatin 10 mg आनी Tamsulosin 0.4 mg घेवपाचीं आसात.

h007.saheli: That is so wonderful to hear, Melroy. Longtime friendships like that bring so much joy and comfort.
h007.text: Just wanted to share that Baba's best friend from his school days is Shalini. She calls him without fail every Sunday, and it always brightens up his day.

h008.saheli: Thank you for the update, Melroy. I have noted Baba's Type 2 diabetes and added Metformin 500 mg at 08:00 and 21:30 to his daily schedule.
h008.text: Hi Saheli, the test results came in, and Baba has been diagnosed with Type 2 diabetes. Dr Joanna Prabhu has started him on Metformin 500 mg at 08:00, 21:30.

h009.saheli: बरें बाबा, नोंद करून घेतली. थोडो वेळ विश्रांती घेयात.

h010.saheli: घरच्यांक मेळून खूब बरें वाटलें आसतलें, बाबा. अशेच दीस खोशयेन वचूं.

h011.saheli: खूब बरें बाबा, तयारी करताना स्वताचेर ताण घेव नाकात आनी विसाव घेत रावा.

h012.saheli: It is such a blessing to have warm and caring neighbours around! Baba must have really enjoyed the visit.
h012.text: Our neighbour Uncle Peter dropped by today with some freshly baked cake. He is always so thoughtful and keeps checking in on Baba.

h013.saheli: गरमागरम शीत आनी नुसतेंची कोडी खावपाक खरेंच वेगळीच रूच येता, बाबा!

h014.saheli: That sounds lovely, Melroy. Simple neighbourly chats about gardening always bring so much cheer to the day.
h014.text: Uncle Peter was telling us about his garden today, he's grown so many fresh chillies and tomatoes this season. Baba was quite happy chatting with him about it.

h015.saheli: बाबा, सद्या तर कसलीच नवी भेट निश्चित जावंक ना. मेलरॉय विचारून थारायतलो.

h016.saheli: Festival memories always bring back such warmth, Melroy! It must be delightful listening to Baba's stories.
h016.text: The festive season is right around the corner, and everyone is already planning what sweets to make at home. Baba has been sharing stories of how they used to celebrate back in the village.

h017.saheli: Please take some restful sleep tonight, Melroy. You deserve a good break after such a tiring day.
h017.text: It has been such an exhausting and hectic day at work today. Just feeling completely drained and ready to crash.

h018.saheli: बरें बाबा, आवडटी मालिका पळोवपाक जाय, मनाक करमणूक मेळटा.

h019.saheli: हय बाबा, हवा हुनाची आसा. उदक पीत रावात आनी थंडायेत बसात.

h020.saheli: Tonight at 21:30, Baba has Metformin 500 mg, Rosuvastatin 10 mg, and Tamsulosin 0.4 mg due.
h020.text: Hi Saheli, could you quickly remind me what medicines Baba has lined up for tonight?

h021.saheli: Hearing Baba laugh like that with the grandchildren is so heartwarming, Melroy. Those moments are truly precious.
h021.text: The kids were playing board games with Baba this evening and making so much noise! Baba was laughing so much, he truly adores having his grandchildren around.

h022.saheli: It is always safest to take medicines with plain water, Melroy, as tea can sometimes interfere with how they work. You can check with Dr Joanna Prabhu for specific tablets.
h022.text: Saheli, Baba was asking if he could take his medicine with his morning cup of tea instead of plain water?

h023.saheli: That is wonderful, Melroy! A sweet milestone to look forward to for little Pooja.
h023.text: Just putting it down here so we remember, our little Pooja's birthday is coming up on 4 November! We'll have to plan something sweet for her.

h025.saheli: Thanks for noting that, Melroy. Domperidone is usually taken before food, but no worries, just let Dr Joanna Prabhu know if he feels any stomach discomfort.
h025.text: Baba took his Domperidone after breakfast today instead of before.

h026.saheli: There is currently no upcoming doctor visit scheduled on Baba's calendar, Melroy.
h026.text: Could you let me know when Baba's next doctor visit is scheduled?

h027.saheli: बरें बाबा, नोंद केली. Pantoprazole चड करून सकाळीं उपाशी पोटी घेतात, फुडल्या खेपे लक्षांत दवरा.

h028.saheli: Thanks for letting me know, Melroy. Just skip tonight's dose so he does not double up, and resume the normal nighttime schedule tomorrow.
h028.text: Baba took his Rosuvastatin after breakfast this morning by mistake instead of keeping it for night.

z01.saheli: Hello Melroy! Please check his latest prescription or confirm with his doctor to be completely sure about the current dose.
z01.text: Hey Saheli, hope you're having a good day. Just wanted to double check Francis's prescription details. What dose of Rosuvastatin does he take now?

z02.saheli: Hi Melroy, I don't have an allergy recorded for Francis right now. It's always best to check directly with him or his doctor to stay safe!
z02.text: Hi Saheli, I was updating Dad's health records today. Could you remind me, is Francis allergic to anything? Just want to keep an eye out.

z03.saheli: Hello Melroy! I don't have his doctor's name on file, so please check his prescription slip or ask Francis directly.
z03.text: Hey Saheli, hope you are doing well! Dad mentioned needing a follow-up visit soon. Who is Francis's doctor currently?

z04.saheli: Hi Melroy, please verify with his latest prescription list or his doctor to see his exact daily count. That will ensure his pill box is perfectly organized!
z04.text: Hi Saheli, I'm trying to help Dad organize his pill box for the coming weeks. How many regular medicines does Francis take now? Want to make sure we haven't missed any.

z05.saheli: Hello Melroy, I don't have his recent lab reports here. Please review the report copies directly or discuss them with his doctor.
z05.text: Hey Saheli, I know Dad went in for some routine blood work recently. What did the tests show for Francis this month? Hope everything came back normal.

z06.saheli: Hi Melroy, what a lovely idea! I don't have his favourite singer noted down, so it might be sweetest to ask Francis himself which classics he's in the mood for.
z06.text: Hi Saheli, I want to make a special playlist for Dad to cheer him up this weekend. Whose songs does Francis love? He's always humming old tunes.

z07.saheli: Hello Melroy! I'm not sure who rings him on Sundays, but it's wonderful to hear those calls brighten his day.
z07.text: Hey Saheli, Dad seemed really happy after his weekend chats recently. Who calls Francis on Sundays? Just wanted to make sure his routine stays smooth.

z08.saheli: Hi Melroy, that is so thoughtful of you! I don't have his favourite dish recorded, so a quick hint from Francis might give you the perfect menu idea.
z08.text: Hi Saheli, I'm planning to cook a nice family meal for Dad this Sunday! What is Francis's favourite dish? Would love to surprise him with something he truly enjoys.

z09.saheli: Hello Melroy! I don't know the name of his 9 pm serial, but Francis will surely love telling you all about the plot!
z09.text: Hey Saheli, Dad was telling me he never misses his evening show. Which TV serial does Francis watch at 9 pm? Just curious what he's following these days.

z10.saheli: Hi Melroy, I don't have Pooja's birthday noted down. It might be quickest to check with the family directly so you can mark the date!
z10.text: Hi Saheli, I'm updating my family calendar so I don't miss any special occasions. When is Pooja's birthday? Want to be ready with a wish in advance.
